items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: Cher was pretending that she didn’t want to do it, but you know it was a pretty good possibility. Nonetheless our focus was on her number.

ctx.x: And it seemed spontaneous but I suspect that you were sort of prepared for it.

We were prepared for the possibility of it. Cher was pretending that she didn’t want to do it, but you know it was a pretty good possibility. Nonetheless our focus was on her number. She had a rock number, climbing the charts at the time and wanted to play that. She made a rock resurgence right at this time. It may have been [sings] “I have found someone” that song. [sings] “To take away the loneliness.” It could have been that one. So we did that and we had time within about fifty minutes — 5-0 — that we have to…
Including the modulation which you did very well.
